decision.rationale:
WHAT I DID
One free transfer: Bobby Thomas (COV, doubtful) out, Konsa (ARS, £4.7m) in. Konsa starts at the back against HUL(h). Haaland is captain and Gabriel is vice. No chip. You still have 4 free transfers available for later weeks.

WHAT I LEARNED
- João Pedro: a 3 Nov report says he has a thigh injury and will be out for several weeks, so he misses sun(a). An injury tracker gives about 21 Nov for his return, around GW12. I recorded him at 0 minutes, which is what the model already had. He sits 4th on the bench. The solver's path sells him in GW12 for N.Jackson.
- Thomas: he went off with a calf problem against Fulham. Lampard later said he was in contention for the weekend, but that quote is about 5 days old and his FPL flag still says 50%. I left him at 33 minutes. He only played as a bench filler anyway.
- Rice: he missed the Fleetwood cup tie about a week ago but trained before it. His FPL flag now shows him fit. I found nothing newer, so I left the model's 88 minutes.
- Konsa: I found no new injury news. He appears in Arsenal's stats this season, so he looks like a regular. His England knock from October is in the past. I left him at 90 minutes.
- Tzolakis: Hull's records show him as their first-choice keeper. Verbruggen against BRE(h) still projects better (4.0 to 3.6), so Verbruggen starts.
- Haaland and Guéhi: City play away at RB Leipzig in the Champions League on 4 Nov, two days before GW10. Guéhi's 63 minutes already allows for rotation. I couldn't confirm Haaland's minutes, so this is still a risk.
- Calvert-Lewin: the only news was about his contract. Nothing affects his minutes.
- I couldn't get current team news for Bournemouth (Tavernier). For everyone apart from João Pedro, nothing I found changed a minute, so I didn't need to re-run the solver.

WHY THIS PLAN
Plan 0 is 2.3 points ahead of rolling (plan 1). That's a small edge, but there's a real football reason behind it: a flagged £4.0m defender is replaced by a nailed £4.7m Arsenal starter at home to Hull. Konsa goes straight into the eleven. The roll plan makes this same swap next week anyway, so doing it now just banks GW10's points.
Plans 2 and 3 take hits for Tarkowski and Barry, and they finish below rolling, so I turned them down.
I didn't use a chip. Triple captain is worth +5.3 this week, below its 6.8 bar, and it's being saved for GW16. Free hit is worth +6.8 against a 13.9 bar.
Konsa has 138k net transfers in, so his price may rise before Friday. That affects timing only, and the transfer is worth doing for football reasons anyway.
